## Owner direction — October 14

> Let's keep a running list of what we plan on upstreaming, and we can do it once we know we have our initial build complete. Do we have any other open items that we've been working on since the last release candidate version of 0.0.1 that we're still waiting to do that came up through testing?

This is the cross-project contribution queue. **Hold upstream submissions until the initial build from the current M7 fix set is complete and the relevant fixes are qualified.** Track and preserve useful patches now; contribution-only preparation or standalone upstream reproduction is not a prerequisite for generating that build. Local defect repair and release qualification remain required. Build completion is not automatic permission to post to an upstream project.

The M7 milestone body remains the ordered release plan. This issue has no M7 milestone because submission is follow-up work, not an RC blocker. #168 retains the detailed RAOfflineProxy patch map; #559 is incoming ROCKNIX integration policy, a different direction of work. Historical broad PR-series issues #256/#333/#335 and toolkit proposals #229–#231/#261 remain separate; this queue does not reopen closed upstream PRs or authorize a large combined submission.

### A vanished package source, `portaudio` (#849, October24)

Queue a focused ROCKNIX/distribution correction to `projects/ROCKNIX/packages/emulators/standalone/hatarisa/portaudio/package.mk`: its `PKG_URL` names `github.com/zhang-ray/portaudio`, a personal fork that has been deleted, while `PKG_SHA256` still names the archive both trees fetched on 2026-08-26 (sha256 `c33e4821…`). Upstream carries the recipe byte for byte. (Corrected the same day: `get_archive` falls back to ROCKNIX's source mirror, which serves the archive with the recipe's sha256, so builds succeed silently; the defect is the dead primary URL, Low.) The fix is a URL that serves the same bytes (re-hosted under an organisation the maintainer chooses) so the pin and checksum stand; a bump to `PortAudio/portaudio` is a separate build decision. Found by the M6 T30 lane (#677); the bytes are on ROCKNIX's mirror and in this host's cache. Held under D-WORKFLOW-165; no upstream post is authorised by this row.



### Generic recipes the image builds: T7's upstream candidates (#654, #884; October24)

Queue the following for ROCKNIX (and, through it, LibreELEC, whose `packages/` these are), each held under D-WORKFLOW-165, none authorising a post:

- **Four dead primary `PKG_URL`s, mirror-covered** (#880 `wsdd2`: the `Netgear/wsdd2` repository is deleted and LibreELEC's new home has no 1.8.7 tag; #881 `newt`: `releases.pagure.org/newt/` serves no archive; #882 `libmpeg2`: a 404 at `libmpeg2.sourceforge.io`; #883 `configtools`: savannah's new cgit host answers 400). Every fetch of the four now depends on ROCKNIX's mirror (`DISTRO_MIRROR`); upstream's choice is a new URL serving the same bytes or an explicit mirror-only note. #849's `portaudio` is the fifth of the class, in ROCKNIX's own tree.
- **Twenty http `PKG_URL`s** (T7's `04` § Q1 at `e5beaa6064` lists them; `glu`'s https redirects to http). Integrity rests on `PKG_SHA256`, which each carries and matched; transport is the modernisation. The fork fixes its own one (`dmidecode`) in T7's S1.
- **Five GitHub `PKG_URL`s on a renamed (3), archived (1) or personally forked (1) repository** (`lm_sensors`, `libfreeaptx`, `nss-mdns`, `oniguruma`, `populatefs`): today's bytes match; a renamed repository's archive is #841's class, an archived one receives no fixes, and `populatefs`'s `kfix` fork is `portaudio`'s shape.
- **Three hunks the fork carries on upstream recipes** (`04` § Q7 rows 1, 2, 13): `libyaml`'s `PKG_DEPENDS_HOST="ccache:host"` (a cold-tree ordering fix), `libsamplerate`'s `--with-pic`, `syslinux`'s two `ldlinux.c32` install lines. Proposed upstream first; a ROCKNIX override that sources the generic recipe is each one's fallback (#645).
